name: agent-tools
description: Guardrails and tools for coding agents, packaged as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: protect-main
plugins.description: Stops Claude Code from running git push to main or master, so changes go through a branch and a pull request.

plugins.name: protect-env
plugins.description: Stops Claude Code from reading or changing .env files, which usually hold secrets. Templates like .env.example stay readable.

plugins.name: protect-destructive
plugins.description: Stops Claude Code from running commands that throw away work for good, like git reset --hard, git clean -f, force-pushes and rm -rf outside the project.
